profile.visual_desc: Armored human in grey plate with a large teal cape. Helmet features a prominent blue plume. Burly build with visible muscular arms beneath pauldrons.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a grey steel greathelm with a dark T-shaped visor. A vibrant blue crest sits atop. Face is fully concealed and stoic.
profile.weapon_desc: Long wooden lance with a silver spearhead, held across the torso with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing UP-LEFT. Character stands in a wide braced stance with the lance held horizontally and cape draped low.
profile.step2_windup: Small torso rotation and backward pull of the spear to build momentum for a forward strike.
profile.step3_impact: Rapid thrust UP-LEFT. A jagged, pale yellow energy wedge erupts from the spearhead, pointing toward the target area.
profile.step4_finish: Lance remains extended as the yellow flash fades. Character resets to a neutral defensive posture.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The yellow energy VFX in Frame 4 must be a jagged triangular burst originating from the spear tip and extending toward the top-left corner.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains reference mechanics. Windup and thrust phases are consistent. VFX alignment and jagged shape match original specifications.
